source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the skin's defence (PDF 170-171).

blocks.text: Skin (jild) hamare jism ki sab se bahar wali teh hai. Yeh microbes ke andar ghusne ke khilaf pehla difa deti hai. Skin ki epidermis (oopar wali teh) 10 se 30 cells moti hoti hai. Epidermis ki sab se bahar wali teh ko stratum corneum kehte hain. Is ke cells musalsal jharte rehte hain kyun ke yeh musalsal ghis kar kharab hote rehte hain. Epidermis ke gehre hisse mein naye cells bante hain jo oopar ki taraf aa kar ghise hue cells ki jagah le lete hain. Yeh cells keratin protein banate hain jo skin ko sakht aur microbes ke liye na-qabil-e-guzar (impenetrable, jis mein se guzra na ja sake) bana deta hai.

blocks.title: For Information (maloomat)
blocks.text: Skin vertebrate jism ka sab se bara uzv (organ) hai. Baaligh insaan ke kul wazan ka 15% skin hai. Insaan ki skin ke aik square centimetre mein 200 nerve endings (asaab ke sire), 10 baal aur muscles, 100 paseene ke glands, 15 tel ke glands, 3 khoon ki naliyan, 12 garmi ke receptors, 2 sardi ke receptors aur 25 dabao (pressure) ke receptors hote hain.

blocks.alt: Jild ka aik tukra kaat kar. Sab se oopar stratum corneum epidermis ka hissa hai. Neeche dermis hai jis mein baal apni thailiyon mein, tel ka ghudood, asab (nerve), khoon ki naliyan aur lipta hua paseene ka ghudood hai jis ki nali pore par khulti hai; sab se neeche charbi (adipose tissue) wali hypodermis. Brackets epidermis, dermis aur hypodermis dikhate hain.

blocks.long_description: Labels: Hair, Pores, Stratum corneum, Epidermis, Oil gland, Nerve, Dermis, Sweat gland, Blood vessels, Hair bulb, Adipose tissue, Hypodermis.

blocks.text: Skin chemicals (kimiyai maadde) chhor kar apna difa aur mazboot karti hai. Skin ke tel (oil) aur paseene (sweat) ke glands skin ki satah ka pH 3 se 5 tak kam kar dete hain. Itni tezabiyat (acid level) bohat se microbes ki barhotri rok deti hai. Paseene mein lysozyme enzyme bhi hota hai jo bohat se bacteria ki cell walls par hamla kar ke unhein hazam kar deta (tor deta) hai.

blocks.prompt: Skin microbes ko bahar rakhne ke liye kaun se do tareeqe istemal karti hai?
blocks.explanation: Koi do: keratin wali sakht teh jo musalsal jharti aur nayi banti rehti hai; tel aur paseene se tezabi satah (pH 3-5); paseene ka lysozyme jo bacteria ki cell walls tor deta hai.

items: Epidermis 10-30 cells moti; stratum corneum ke cells jharte aur neeche se naye aate hain; keratin skin ko sakht banata hai.
Tel aur paseene ke glands pH 3-5 karte hain; paseene ka lysozyme bacteria ki cell walls hazam karta hai.
